camel_example: aliyun rds DescribeDBInstancesByExpireTime --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 30 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmy0000' --PageNumber 1 --Expired true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ExpirePeriod 180 --Tags 'key1_:_value1' --proxyId API
description_en: Queries information about ApsaraDB RDS instances based on the remaining available time of subscription instances
description_zh: 该接口用于通过包年包月实例的剩余可用时间查询RDS实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-instances-by-expire-time --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --proxy-id API --expire-period 180 --expired true --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --tags key1_:_value1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstancesByExpireTime

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to obtain the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: A deprecated parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter
parameters.name: proxy_id

parameters.help_en: The remaining available days of the instance. Valid values: 0 to 180
parameters.help_zh: 实例剩余可用天数。取值：0~180
parameters.name: expire_period

parameters.help_en:
The expiration status of the instance. Valid values:

True: The instance has expired.
False: The instance has not expired
parameters.help_zh:
实例的过期状态，取值：

True：已过期
False：未过期
parameters.name: expired

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：1~100。

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. The value must be greater than 0 and must not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer类型的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The tags that are bound to the instance, including TagKey and TagValue. You can specify up to 5 tag pairs at a time. Format: `{"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"...}`
parameters.help_zh: 查询绑定有该标签的实例，包括TagKey和TagValue。单次最多支持传入5组值，格式：`{"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"...}`
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call DescribeDBInstanceAttribute to obtain the resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

DBInstanceStatus.description_en: The instance status. For more information, see [Instance states]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26315.html）
DBInstanceStatus.description_zh: 实例状态。详情请参见[实例状态表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26315.html）

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the instance expires. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC. Pay-as-you-go instances do not have an endpoint expiration time
ExpireTime.description_zh: 实例到期时间。yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 按量付费实例无到期时间

LockMode.description_en:
The lock mode of the instance. Valid values:

Unlock: Normal.
ManualLock: Manually locked.
LockByExpiration: Automatically locked due to instance expiration.
LockByRestoration: Automatically locked before instance rollback.
LockByDiskQuota: Automatically locked due to full instance storage.
LockReadInstanceByDiskQuota: Automatically locked due to full read-only instance storage
LockMode.description_zh:
实例锁定模式。取值：

Unlock：正常
ManualLock：手动触发锁定
LockByExpiration：实例过期自动锁定
LockByRestoration：实例回滚前的自动锁定
LockByDiskQuota：实例空间满自动锁定
LockReadInstanceByDiskQuota：只读实例空间满自动锁定

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
PayType.description_zh:
实例付费方式。取值：

Postpaid：按量付费
Prepaid：包年包月

PageNumber.description_en:
The page number. The value must be greater than 0 and must not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type.

Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer类型的最大值。

默认值：1

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of instances on the current page
